# Document fixtures

All text, drawings and package XML in these fixtures are original rustX test
content under this repository's MIT license. No third-party document content is
included. `python3 generate.py` regenerates the PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX and HTML
fixtures with fixed ZIP timestamps and fixed PDF object offsets.

- `sample.pdf`: three textual pages, for navigation, zoom and selectable text.
- `sample.docx`, `sample.pptx`: real minimal OPC packages, exercised through the
  real sandboxed system LibreOffice converter (not mocked converted outputs).
- `sample.xlsx`: two sheets; `C1` stores formula `A1+B1` and deliberately stale
  cached value `99`; `D1` stores `NOW()` with no cached result. A viewer must not
  evaluate either formula.
- `benign.html`, `hostile.html`: static rendering and script, parent, storage,
  form, navigation, popup and external-resource threats.
- `malformed.pdf`: deliberately invalid PDF data.
- `encrypted.pdf`: password `preview-test`, made from `sample.pdf` with the
  locally installed Ghostscript command below. It is a committed test input;
  Ghostscript is not a product or test-runtime dependency. PDF generation IDs
  can vary, so this encrypted fixture is not regenerated by `generate.py`.

```sh
gs -q -dBATCH -dNOPAUSE -sDEVICE=pdfwrite -sOwnerPassword=owner \
  -sUserPassword=preview-test -dEncryptionR=3 -dKeyLength=128 \
  -sOutputFile=encrypted.pdf sample.pdf
```

Archive attack cases are constructed in memory by `document-archive.test.ts`.
There is no committed large archive bomb, converter profile or extracted tree.
